title: Message too short or too long

entities.name: Message length error
entities.description: Condition where a received NAS message is either shorter or longer than expected based on the protocol specification.

entities.name: NAS message
entities.description: A Non-Access Stratum message exchanged between UE and network.

entities.name: Message discard procedure
entities.description: Procedure to discard a received NAS message that does not conform to length requirements.

relations.description: The message length error condition applies to NAS messages that are too short or too long.
Detection of a message length error triggers the message discard procedure.
